title: A native noisy-IQP average-case conjecture implies a constant-TV sampling obstruction
statement: The source proves a CONDITIONAL implication: an efficiently samplable rational nearest-neighbor2D continuous-noise IQP ensemble satisfying the stated native anticoncentration and average-case probability-hardness hypothesis, together with PH noncollapse, rules out a polynomial-BIT constant-TV sampler at one fixed g0. This eta0 subclass belongs to every positive-eta neighborhood, so the same assumptions obstruct the universal neighborhood proposition. The model-specific N2D-IQP(g0) conjecture is ADDITIONAL AND UNPROVED; unconditional native robust-TV hardness and the full unconditional sampling phase remain OPEN. Hypothetical sampler worst-case polynomial BIT work gives a polynomial random tape. Stockmeyer approximate counting estimates its output q_C(x) within multiplicative1/16 in FBPP^NP. At epsilon0=alpha beta/128, L1(p_C-q_C)<=2epsilon0 and Markov give absolute error<=alpha/(16*2^n) outside beta/4 mass; intersect with anticoncentration to get at least3beta/4 good pairs. Multiplicative approximation adds <=17/256+1/16<1/4 relative error; finite failure budget leaves beta/2 fraction. Constant requested TV accuracy and polynomial complete rational input prevent a hidden exponentially fine epsilon. This is a proof-only hypothetical counting reduction, not a constructed sampler or native-hardness proof.
